summary: Japanese browser/live-service game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Kantai Collection
entries.definitive_edition: Current official DMM/KanColle HTML5 browser service with account/event state documented

emulation.notes: Use official browser/Android service; preserve screenshots/notes of event state.

primary.why: Kantai Collection is a Japanese free-to-play browser fleet-management game whose Flash-era client moved to HTML5 and whose event/content state is live. The archive route must record DMM account/region access, event state, fleet roster, and client version rather than treating it as a static offline game.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official DMM browser/Android service where accessible. Record access method, region/account state, server, event period, fleet roster, remodel/quest state, monetization, browser/client version, and whether the PS Vita Kai version was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Offline-ish Vita adaptation with different structure
secondary.what_to_play: Use separately if documenting the Vita adaptation.
secondary.why: It is not the same live browser service route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original and current live-service browser route.
Official mobile access tied to the same account/service.
all_releases.reason: primary if Android is the available official access route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Service content, events, account/fleet state, and regional access define what can be archived.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record account/server/fleet state, event period, client/browser, region access, and monetization.
